answer: A slashable bond turns sybil creation into a losing bet: every identity must lock a bond that is destroyed if the identity is ever proven fake, and attestors who vouched for it lose their stake too. To forge a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds, and a single comet of detection burns the whole cluster at once. The island of honest agents stays safe because lying costs real collateral while truth costs nothing. Attackers cannot outnumber honest users when each fake identity must pay upfront and can lose everything on one exposure.
